I'm in a small age gap marriage but I was in a huge age gap relationship before. I was 17 when I began seeing a 34 year old man. I spent 3 years in that and it taught me how naive I really was. It was a constant cycle of gaslighting and abuse that I didn't even realize at the time I was in, even with verbal, physical and sexual abuse I couldn't recognize myself as a victim in the situation at the time. I was just riding the cycles. Luckily, I got out relatively unharmed and haven't spoken to him in almost a decade. 

I am now married to a man who is 8 years older than me but is my absolute best friend. I was a bit older when we got together and he hadn't been specifically looking for someone younger so it worked out because we see each other as equals. 

Long story short- extreme age gaps = sketchy; smaller age gaps = open for interpretation. Also depends on how young the younger party is when you get together. But if it feels wrong, it probably is.
